## Topics

This module covers the short course [Intro to Federated Learning](https://www.deeplearning.ai/short-courses/intro-to-federated-learning/) by DeepLearning.AI in partnership with Flower Labs, taught by Daniel Beutel, co-creator of the open source [Flower](https://flower.ai/) framework. It is the first course of a two-course series, and the follow-up on federated fine-tuning of large language models may join this module later.
